description: This file is a shell script used for testing reading and writing the .gitmodules file in various scenarios involving sparse checkouts and submodule management in Git. It contains setup, test cases, and cleanup steps related to submodule behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case step expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test step expecting failure.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified path is missing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates time passing for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
